scope: the declared twelve simple chiral C^6 bimodule sectors of claim 1529, with unit multiplicity and no sourced Pati-Salam tensor factors

centralGaugeAction.rule: a central infinitesimal theta acts on e_ab with charge theta_a-theta_b

unimodularity.convention: Tr_H pi(theta)=0 on the declared twelve-state left representation
unimodularity.effect: the trace hyperplane is transverse to the trivially acting diagonal and therefore gives one unique representative of every effective charge class; it does not reduce the effective continuous dimension below five
unimodularity.gaugeLiftTrace: Tr_H(pi(theta)-pi_o(theta))=0 identically because every e_ab is paired with e_ba, so imposing trace on the lifted charge itself would be vacuous

anomalyConvention.normalization: the six gamma=+1 representatives give the declared chiral normalization; Tr_H(gamma Q^n) on all twelve states is twice this for odd n and has the same zero locus

cubicGaugeAnomaly.factorizedOnGravitationalKernelModuloDia: with P=0 and S=U, A_3=3[N I (I-N)+T S (S-T)]

maximalSimultaneousAnomalyFreeSubspace.chargePairing: on this subspace the charges of (SP,PT,TU) are the negatives of (PN,NI,IP), respectively
maximalSimultaneousAnomalyFreeSubspace.maximality: after A_grav=0 and quotienting the diagonal, the cubic is the smooth projective cubic surface F=NI(I-N)+TS(S-T) in P^3; a three-dimensional vector subspace would give a projective plane contained in that surface, forcing a linear factor and contradicting smoothness
maximalSimultaneousAnomalyFreeSubspace.singleDirectionBoundary: additional isolated anomaly-free U(1) rays lie on the cubic zero locus, but they do not enlarge the displayed simultaneous anomaly-free linear gauge algebra

addedCharacterOnlySlice.definition: theta_P=theta_I=theta_N=0, so only the added S,T,U character phases are switched on before quotienting the diagonal
addedCharacterOnlySlice.interpretation: nontrivial added-only U(1) directions exist, but no two-dimensional added-only plane is simultaneously anomaly-free

minimalRepairOptions: gauge only an anomaly-free subalgebra such as the displayed u(1)^2 and keep the other central label directions global or absent
supply additional chiral bimodule multiplicities whose linear and cubic tensors cancel the residual anomalies
supply a physical central extension or correspondence that selects the actual gauged combinations before anomaly evaluation
physicalDecision.reopeningDatum: a physical lift fixing which center combinations are gauged, all fermion multiplicities and Pati-Salam tensor factors; any added spectrum must cancel both the mixed-gravitational covector and the complete symmetric cubic tensor

boundary: The anomaly result is exact for the declared unit-multiplicity C^6 label spectrum. Tensoring sectors with physical colour, weak, family or generation multiplicities changes the trace weights and must be recomputed; no Standard-Model or Pati-Salam anomaly claim follows from this label-only calculation.
